description: Entry 9's cal-anchored wall, quantified from the other side. The corpus bounds IDENTIFYING c_3 from data (6.99-digit deficit); this bounds what a DERIVED c_3 would buy. An exact c_3 leaves |c_4|*u^4, so the L2 target is met iff |c_4| <= 1.4816. Cuts both ways: one derived rung closes the whole gap, BUT |c_2|=1 and |c_3|=2.069, and continuing that growth puts |c_4|~4.3, missing by ~2.9x. Also shows the cached c_3 IS the greedy annihilating value and the cached c_4=0 is a greedy artifact carrying no evidence.

checks.why: k=3 tier='cal-anchored' — extracted from CAL-3 Q_codata

checks.name: k3_residual_is_exactly_zero
checks.why: the cache's 0.0 ppb at k=3 is the EXTRACTION, not a measurement — so the cache cannot answer what a DERIVED c_3 would leave

checks.name: cache_u_is_exactly_recomputable_from_q0
checks.why: ck-cache u reproduces from its own q_0 to 4.246e-51 — the cache is self-consistent

checks.why: qbeta-ck-basis-constrained-pslq records u = 0.0085172363404849214399, which is u at the MUON pin (match 7.091e-32) while the same witness records q0_proton and c3_proton_on_record — a LAYER STRADDLE, 2.10201e-7 relative

checks.name: straddle_does_NOT_change_the_pslq_conclusion
checks.why: the amplifier is off by 1.872e-6 relative, i.e. 8.13e-7 effective digits, against that witness's 6.99-digit deficit — its identification bound STANDS; only the recorded u / amplifiers are on the wrong layer

checks.name: amplifier_dc4_is_inverse_u_fourth_at_its_own_layer
checks.why: 1/amplifier_dc4 = 5.262532484e-9 vs muon-pin u^4 = 5.262532534e-9 — consistent once the layer is identified

checks.name: extracted_c3_is_exactly_the_annihilating_value
checks.why: c_3 required to zero the k=2 residual = -2.06934522294; cache value = -2.06934257712; rel 1.279e-6 — confirms the cached c_3 IS the greedy extraction, not an independent value

checks.name: growth_trend_would_MISS_the_target
checks.why: |c_2|=1, |c_3|=2.0693426; continuing that ratio gives |c_4|~4.28218 > 1.48218 — a perfect c_3 would then STILL miss, by ~2.889x

checks.name: k5_is_below_target_regardless
checks.why: u^5 = 0.0448222 ppb, 174.021x below target — so the question is entirely about c_3 and c_4

checks.name: cached_c4_zero_is_a_greedy_artifact
checks.why: c_4 = 0.0 is what greedy extraction leaves once c_3 has annihilated the residual (QOU.QBeta.greedy_later_rungs_vanish) — it must NOT be read as evidence that |c_4| < 1.4816

data.scope: Scope (a). No c_k proposed, extracted, fitted or wired. No D-frame Q_beta computed — the producer's convention-D refusal stands untouched. The conclusion is CONDITIONAL on |c_4|, which is underived; the cached 0.0 is a greedy artifact and is not evidence.
